reasoning: Praxis is a Rust-based proxy server that builds a standalone binary (praxis-proxy) from the crates/server crate. It uses Pingora as its underlying proxy framework and provides HTTP/TCP traffic proxying with a filter pipeline, routing, TLS termination, and hot-reload capabilities. The project ships as a container image (Containerfile) and runs as a long-lived network service. While it describes itself as a 'framework for building proxy servers', the checkout produces a concrete deployable proxy service binary, not a library consumed by other projects. It is not a Kubernetes operator (no CRDs, reconcilers, or operator-sdk patterns), nor configuration-only. Classification: service (proxy server).
